original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿达马瓦州因烤肉的争执致一人死亡，嫌疑人已被逮捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿达马瓦州警方逮捕一名28岁男子，其被指在穆比北地方政府区因烤肉纠纷用刀刺死一名21岁男子。警方发言人称，事件发生于周三晚约8时，死者父亲于当晚约20时45分报案。案件目前为单一来源报道，具体细节尚待进一步核实。

location.raw_text: Mararaban Vimtim, Mubi North Local Government Area, Adamawa State

key_facts.fact: 阿达马瓦州警方逮捕一名28岁男子，其被指刺死一名21岁男子
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Adamawa State Police Command has arrested one Ibrahim Augustine, 28, of Mararaban Vimtim, Mubi North Local Government Area, in connection with the death of Haggai Markus, 21

key_facts.fact: 事件起因是两人因烤肉发生争执
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the deceased reportedly had a misunderstanding with the suspect over roasted meat taken from a butcher’s table at Mararaban Vimtim on Wednesday at about 8pm

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指用刀刺中死者胸部
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In the course of the misunderstanding, the suspect allegedly used a knife and stabbed the victim in the chest

key_facts.fact: 死者父亲于当晚约20时45分向警方报案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident was reported to the police at about 2045hrs on the same date by the father of the deceased

uncertainties: 嫌疑人是否实施刺击仅为警方指控，尚未经司法确认
事件细节目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
